design_philosophy: Functional clarity meets industrial robustness. The interface must prioritize fast transaction entries and readable inventory data, ensuring it looks tailored on both small mobile screens and wide desktop monitors without structural stretching.

page_container.implementation: Use a global Container component that checks useWindowDimensions().width to apply maxWidth and centered alignment on web.

responsive_columns.implementation: For desktop, utilize flex basis (e.g., width: '48%') or CSS Grid if using NativeWind/Web. Avoid setting fixed heights.

card_stretching_prevention.strategy: On web, restrict card widths by applying a maximum width or grouping them in a multi-column flex layout instead of allowing flex: 1 to fill the entire row infinitely.

auth.card_sizing: maxWidth: 400, width: '100%', padding: 32, borderRadius: 16, backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', shadow.
auth.mobile: Takes up full width minus margins.
auth.desktop: Perfectly centered in the middle of the screen.

dashboard_summary.mobile: 1 column vertical list of metric cards.
dashboard_summary.desktop: 3 or 4 column layout (flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap'). Each card width approx 30% or 23%.

cashier_pos.layout: Two-pane layout for desktop, collapsible or stacked for mobile.
cashier_pos.mobile: 1 column: Product grid takes full space. A floating action button (FAB) or bottom sheet displays the current Cart summary.
cashier_pos.desktop: 2 columns: Left pane (70% width) for Product Grid/Search, Right pane (30% width, sticky or fixed) for Cart/Order Summary and Checkout button.

inventory_transactions.desktop: Container maxWidth: 800 or 1000. Do not let list items stretch to 1920px. Use a multi-column grid for inventory items if they are cards, or a stylized table/list layout for transactions.

details_screens.layout: Workshop Details, User Details, Settings, About
details_screens.mobile: Vertical stacking of form fields and info cards.
details_screens.desktop: MaxWidth: 600 - 800. Group related form fields into side-by-side columns (2 columns for form inputs).

toolbar_wrapping.strategy: Action bars (Search, Filter, Add New) should use flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap' to gracefully wrap onto the next line if screen width shrinks, instead of squishing elements.

components.Card: Solid background, subtle border (1px solid #E5E7EB), no heavy shadows. Rounded corners (8px).
components.Button: Industrial bold. Primary CTA uses the primary color (#FF5722) with white text. Hover state on web should darken.
components.Input: Large touch targets for mobile (min-height: 48px). Clear borders, focus states must have high contrast (2px solid #111827).

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, forms, and key text fields MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='cashier-checkout-button', data-testid='inventory-search-input').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement these responsive patterns using Expo React Native. Create a responsive wrapper or hook (e.g., useWindowDimensions) to toggle between mobile (width < 768) and desktop layouts. Ensure NativeWind or StyleSheet properties apply maxWidth to prevent web components from unbounded horizontal stretching. For Cashier, build a split-screen view on desktop. Do not use placehold.it or similar; rely on generic icons or local static assets.
